items.title: Shipped: agent-loop v1 (planner/executor)
items.text: Designed and wrote forgeline-core/agent-loop, the plan -> act -> verify loop behind the fl CLI. RFC-007 adopted by Agent Eng and IDE teams. Took FL-Bench task success from 31% to 48% in 2025.

items.title: H1 2026 review (L5) — Exceeds
items.text: Reviewer: Marcus Oyelaran. Strong technical direction-setter on agent architecture; RFCs are the team's reference. Growth: broaden mentoring beyond Agent Eng; reduce single-point-of-failure risk on agent-loop.

items.title: Spike: transcript carry-over as memory (FL-3977) — rejected
items.text: Tried carrying the previous session transcript into context. Cost +2.4x, context bloat, propagated wrong assumptions. Conclusion: need distilled, retrievable memory records keyed to repo/path with provenance — a retrieval/storage problem. Recommended Platform own the store with Agent Eng owning loop integration.

items.title: Peer feedback
items.text: Tobias Greer: 'Sam's failure analyses are the clearest thinking on the team.' Jordan Rivera: 'Sam makes cross-team collaboration easy; always willing to co-design.'
